### 实现与数据约定

| 项目 | 规定 |
| --- | --- |
| 本版数量 | 主报告1776个独立可实现候选（当前真实历史不足的4个15/20年季节性因子已移至未纳入清单；另有4个与原有200项完全相同的新增项已删除并归并到原有因子）。历史恢复阶段曾在1032个代表项基础上新增保留750个，并重新归并旧/新重复项；本次再去除上述4个重复项。统计按固定窗口及单一输出逐项计数，原来源模板ID数量与展开后的因子数不同。当前审计覆盖原2693个PF代表条目和通联424项目录，共3117个来源ID；Fama–French9条已在PF范围内，不再次叠加。未纳入原始条目1397个；重复映射114条，另列已恢复模板内仍不合格的单列输出。 |
| 适用范围 | 本报告的可实现是：公式、逐字段输入、数值算法和本地参数契约已闭合，可以独立编写MLFactors因子；不表示已生成生产代码或验收真实历史数据。只保留可实现代表因子；未纳入项及去重映射见《公开因子库_未纳入实现清单及原因.md》。Alpha158按已实现处理，不再提供。 |
| 实现入口与优先级 | 每行必须合读公式、字段、实现方法及本表。附录完整数值核是该行算法定义的一部分，不是让实现者再联网寻找代码。若源码片段与原目录泛化文字不一致，采用本行固定参数、输出选择和完整数值核；明示local的是本地明确版本，不冒充未公开的供应商生产程序。 |
| R1 日历与输入 | stock_day按ts_code/trade_date唯一、日期升序；先检查同键重复和冲突，禁止多对多连接。窗口d是交易日位置，不按自然日，也不先删除缺日压缩窗口。框架交易日和当日成分/状态上下文保持原接口；ST/停牌和成员状态遮罩按现有运行层执行。输入的业务数值列之外，主键ts_code/trade_date用于对齐。指数按同日精确连接，不用股票数据代替指数。 |
| R2 单位与有效性 | O/H/L/C分别为stock_day.open_hfq/high_hfq/low_hfq/close_hfq；V=vol×100股，A=amount×1000元，P=A/V×adj_factor，MC=total_mv×10000元。价格&gt;0，H&gt;=max(O,C)，L&lt;=min(O,C)，H&gt;=L，量额非负；非有限数和不合规则为NaN。adj_factor&gt;0；成交均价另要求V&gt;0。stock_day股本以万股计，financial_balance_sheet.total_share以股计，不能混用。字段存在不等于已具有正确历史覆盖和原始缺失标识。 |
| R3 单股票数值适配 | 日频技术核逐股执行，完整交易日轴上把所需输入全部有限的连续区段分开；无效日输出NaN，不压缩跨越缺失，下一连续有效区段重新初始化。允许零量但禁止零分母；派生量的算法内NaN按核本身传播，不能把正常预热当作新输入区段。每个区段保留完整初始化历史，不能每月/每年重置递推状态；跨分区缓存状态或回读自区段起点。区段短于核初始化要求时整段NaN，空输入返回同形NaN，不调用会越界的种子代码。附录输出inf/−inf统一转NaN。核明确的特殊0/0中立规则优先，否则除0为NaN；不能用全局fillna(0)清洗结果。 |
| R4 有限窗口、预热与移位 | 普通算术rolling(N)默认min_periods=N；完整数值核中明确的不同预热、ddof、EMA种子、min_periods或中立值按核执行。固定gate_bars时，对短数组及长数组的同一开头都遮前gate_bars−1行；不能只检查总长度。时间移位按交易日轴；禁止负向shift把未来值回写过去，向后排布的已知指标可以用正shift。alld只用于累计/递推且无固定期间参数的定义；具体固定平滑参数仍写在调用契约。 |
| R5 横截面与Alpha算子 | Alpha表达式整体在date×symbol面板求值；不能套用R3逐股切段来计算横截面rank。rank为运算发生日有效当日成员的平均并列秩/有效数；scale(x,a)=a×x/sum(abs(x))，分母0为NaN；行业去均值按历史当日industry_sw_1/2/3。缺行业为NaN，不能使用今天分类回填过去。ts_rank取完整窗口末值平均并列秩/N；argmax/min为最早到最新1…N位置，重复极值取首次。std/cov默认ddof=1；corr常数样本为NaN。decay_linear为最老1至最新N的归一化权重；SignedPower=sign(x)abs(x)^a；log仅正数；非整数窗口向下取整；advN=平均实际成交额A。条件未知须NaN，不按False分支计算；原式所列窗口、行业层级和分支保留。 |
| Q1 回填前检查与统一后处理 | 2026-10-18已逐项检查原1984个因子的未回填双版本Parquet，修复递推退化与无穷值并停用4个历史不足配方。用户最新指定：对当前1976项双版本沿日期逐股票先ffill，再fillna(0)，不按空值原因分组、不因低覆盖阻塞；仅输出当日成分股。R3–R5缺失规则适用于因子数学计算阶段，统一回填是其后的独立处理。检查基线与最新执行口径见《因子值全量检查报告.md》。 |
| R6 输出与注册 | 继承factors/base.py的BaseFactor，以本行字段声明ParquetInput，再按registry.py现有register_factor/fixed_factor机制注册；generate_signals(data,constituents)返回date×symbol浮点矩阵。不得把中间多列直接作为一个因子；每行仅选择指定的一列。横截面算子在自己的发生日先遮当日非成员；最终再按输出日成员及框架交易状态遮罩。价格/财报日终信号至少用于随后可交易时点，禁止当日盘前使用当日收盘字段。报告只规定本批因子计算，不修改现有回测执行价。 |
| R7 名称、窗口与类别 | 名称仅小写字母/数字/下划线，后缀d交易日、m自然月、q财季、y财年；多窗口分别写出，跳过期n表示滞后区间。窗口是参数/比较跨度，不统一等同总预热条数；Alpha101/191沿用最少历史观测数，Alpha360为lag+1。财务1q指最近已知报告刷新粒度，YTD不是单季；4q指TTM。周期模板现由本报告固定，不再仅因未给默认周期而剔除。分类沿用九类，不用无含义或分钟；本次保留项均使用日频/财务输入。 |
| F1 公告生效与版本 | 对每股票、每个财务表先保留合并报表report_type=1；若原字段为字符串先规范成同一编码。可知日a=非空有效f_ann_date，否则ann_date；两者均无效则该记录不可用。effective_day=交易日历中严格大于a的第一日；不能在公告当日使用。对每信号日t，仅读取effective_day&lt;=t的记录。按ts_code/end_date选截至t已生效的最大公告日版本；相同公告日完全相同记录可去重，不同所需数值冲突且无可靠顺序字段则该键标为不确定并输出NaN，禁止按文件行顺序挑一条。后来的修订只影响生效后的日期。 |
| F2 报告期锚定 | 季度报告期只接受03-31/06-30/09-30/12-31，按年季编号定位q−k，禁止把缺期跳过。每行涉及多个表时q为这些表已知报告期集合交集的最大值；同一期必要科目缺失输出NaN，不因数值缺失悄悄回退到更早完整报告。需要lag报告和TTM时在同一个截至t的快照中查询。只用年报的条目改在12-31集合中取最新共同财年y，所有y−k也必须为12-31报告。 |
| F3 期间与TTM | B(X,q)为资产负债期末存量，不差分。QY(X,q)为利润/现金流表原始YTD累计，EPS类原值按行定义直接读，不相加成TTM。单季Q(X,q)：Q1=YTD(Q1)，Q2/Q3/Q4=本季YTD−同一财年上季度YTD；任一期缺失则单季NaN。T(X,q)=Q(q)+Q(q−1)+Q(q−2)+Q(q−3)，四个连续单季均有效才计算；可优化为YTD(q)+上年年报−上年同季YTD，但必须核对四季连续性和同一快照版本，不能绕过缺期约束。Y(X,y)为12-31的完整财年累计；余额类Y为年末B。 |
| F4 财务符号与同轴运算 | T(X)未写q时指F2最新共同q；B、QY同理。AVG4(X)=(B(X,q)+B(X,q−4))/2，不是最近四季均值。旧学术公式的物理映射逐行给出，后缀_y为已知完整年度、_q为单季流量或期末存量，lag只按报告期编号匹配。所有减法、同比、均值、CAGR先在报告期轴完成；只有本行明确写交易日shift(252)的Tushare定义先构造历史PIT日频序列再按日移位。 |
| F5 比率与增长 | 全部财报金额保持元，EPS和每股金额元/股，比例输出小数；分母0、负号不合本行限制或任一所需科目缺失时输出NaN，不把缺科目当0。若本行给abs(基期)，严格用绝对值；未给abs则保留有符号基期。CAGR两端均&gt;0；小数开方不用有符号替代。365为固定年化天数、252为固定交易日年化数，仅在本行明示时使用。非金融科目对不适用行业缺失时不做主观补造。 |
| F6 日频映射 | 先对每个生效事件后的PIT快照计算报告期因子，再按effective_day向后merge_asof到交易日；同日多表变更统一构造更新后的快照。market-cap分母/分子类用信号当日MC，与该日已知的财报组合，不使用期末后才公告的财报。需要每天截面rank的条目在PIT日频映射后按当日有效样本计算；财报映射前不提前做历史全样本排名。 |
| F7 数据前置与降级规则 | 实际实施先检查各必需表公告历史、修订版本、字段单位、可用日期和覆盖；只有最新重述报表而没有历史版本时，无法保证PIT，不得宣称已完成可回测实现。既有清洗字段可能已前填/补0/后填行业，不能把清洗填充值当原始真实观测；需原始缺失标识或可核验的源记录。报告字段支持判断不绕过这些历史数据验收要求；本次未验收真实历史。 |
| 源码维护与许可 | 过时API不等于数学不可实现。独立数值核已避开旧库安装、闭源API及SAS运行时；使用NumPy/Pandas，个别公开算法使用SciPy基础数值函数。附录源片段遵循各自原许可：TA-Lib BSD，ta/PyTI/bta-lib MIT，FinTA/Tulip LGPL-3.0，Pandas TA Classic MIT，Stockstats BSD-3-Clause；对应许可证全文附在本报告。修改包括独立依赖展开、旧API替换、固定参数、因果性修正，不能将修正版冒充原作者/供应商逐值结果。学术公开公式与可复制源码许可分开判断。 |
| 去重边界 | 同一窗口、输入经济含义/单位、完整数学定义及关键种子一致才合并。年度和TTM、归母和含少数股东、流通和总股本、前复权价格水平和后复权水平、总体和样本标准差、EMA不同种子均不自动归并。多输出逐列核定；相关性高不是重复。数学来源别名和映射单独列在未纳入报告，不作为无法计算的因子。 |
| Alpha191环境 | alpha191_eval(expression_tree,env)按调用契约的字面量树调用；env中O/H/L/C/V/A/P按R2绑定为同索引date×symbol面板，BO/BC为同日中证500open/close广播至股票列。R=C/C.shift(1)−1；HD=H−H.shift(1)，LD=L.shift(1)−L；TR为H−L、abs(H−C.shift(1))、abs(L−C.shift(1))三者逐元素最大，任一必需输入缺失保持NaN。DTM=O&lt;=O.shift(1)时0，否则max(H−O,O−O.shift(1))；DBM=O&gt;=O.shift(1)时0，否则max(O−L,O−O.shift(1))，保留原文第二项符号；比较输入未知时NaN。_eligible为逐历史日成员/交易状态有效的布尔面板，rank节点在自身发生日用它遮罩；不能用输出日成员代替整段历史成员。只构造公式用到的环境量；核需C作形状模板，若该式不使用C且未列close字段，则env['C']只放同形NaN模板，不额外读收盘价。WMA固定0.9指数距离权重，SMA固定N连续有效值均值种子及M/N递推；其余算子按核，不请求外部解析器。 |
| K线共享阈值/宏 | K线共享定义：Body=abs(C−O)，Upper=H−max(O,C)，Lower=min(O,C)−L，Range=H−L，Color=(C&gt;=O?+1:−1)；BodyLong和BodyShort阈值均为前10实体均值，BodyVeryLong为前10实体均值×3，BodyDoji为前10Range均值×0.1；ShadowLong=当前实体，ShadowVeryLong=2×当前实体；ShadowShort为前10(Upper+Lower)均值/2；ShadowVeryShort为前10Range均值×0.1；Near、Far、Equal分别为前5Range均值的0.2、0.6、0.05倍。TA_CANDLERANGE按设置分别取Body/Range/Upper+Lower；TA_CANDLEAVERAGE=该设置factor×(N&gt;0时前N项平均，否则取当前Range值)，仅Shadows范围再除2；形态先判断后更新均值，不含当前根。TA_REALBODYGAPUP(i,j)=min(O_i,C_i)&gt;max(O_j,C_j)，GAPDOWN反向；TA_CANDLEGAPUP(i,j)=L_i&gt;H_j，GAPDOWN为H_i&lt;L_j。std_fabs/fabs=abs，std_fmin/min和std_fmax/max为点态最小/最大；STREAM宏同一公式只把数组索引替换为传入的OHLC标量。源码中的全局平均窗口均在公式头固定，i仅向前推进到当前endIdx。 &#124; |

### TA-Lib（技术指标及K线形态）｜[来源](https://github.com/TA-Lib/ta-lib/blob/481dda1b10350468e82221b17fe84f6bb24e122d/ta_func_api.xml)｜独立可实现因子数：238

| 因子名称 | 公式定义 | 所需字段（来源表） | 支持情况 | 实现方法 | 类别 |

| finta_frama_16_10d | 固定公开源码默认参数：{'period': 16, 'batch': 10}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：FRAMA(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=16, batch: int=10): assert period % 2 == 0, print('FRAMA period must be even')<br>c = ohlc.close.copy()<br>window = batch * 2<br>hh = c.rolling(batch).max()<br>ll = c.rolling(batch).min()<br>n1 = (hh - ll) / batch<br>n2 = n1.shift(batch)<br>hh2 = c.rolling(window).max()<br>ll2 = c.rolling(window).min()<br>n3 = (hh2 - ll2) / window<br>D = (np.log(n1 + n2) - np.log(n3)) / np.log(2)<br>alp = np.exp(-4.6 * (D - 1))<br>alp = np.clip(alp, 0.01, 1).values<br>filt = c.values<br>for i, x in enumerate(alp):<br>    cl = c.values[i]<br>    if i &lt; window:<br>        continue<br>    filt[i] = cl * x + (1 - x) * filt[i - 1]<br>return pd.Series(filt, index=ohlc.index, name='{0} period FRAMA.'.format(period))；原目录：FRAMA（period=16, batch=10）；追踪：PF00978；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。 本地数值修正：完整window=2*batch=20条平价收盘窗口使n3=0且n1+n2=0时，明确alpha=1，跟随唯一已观测价格，避免NaN永久污染；其他分形维数与裁剪公式不变。 | `open_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`high_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`low_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`close_hfq`（`stock_day`） | 可独立实现；已修复完整平价窗口永久NaN并重算 | 逐symbol按R3连续有限OHLC切段；先按原函数用收盘价计算10条及20条极差、分形维数和alpha。本地数值修正：完整window=2*batch=20条平价收盘窗口使n3=0且n1+n2=0时，明确alpha=1，跟随唯一已观测价格，避免NaN永久污染；其他分形维数与裁剪公式不变。 保留原源码前20条直接输出收盘价的行为，第21条起按alpha*C+(1-alpha)*前一状态递推；不新增输出ffill，不改变period=16、batch=10默认参数或其实际20条极差窗口。真实缺失由R3切段，下一段独立初始化。实际实现位于已有factors/base.py；入口factors/momentum/finta_frama_16_10d.py。 | 动量 (momentum) |

| finta_vbm_vbm_12_26d | 源码实际为(Δ_n C−lag_n C)/ATR(v)=(C−2lag_n C)/ATR(v)，与其注释(C−lag_n C)/ATR(v)不一致，需固定修正版本；确切输出列/初始化见[源码](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta/blob/af01fa594995de78f5ada5c336e61cd87c46b151/finta/finta.py#L664)。；固定默认参数={'roc_period': 12, 'atr_period': 26, 'column': 'close'}；实际单列输出='VBM'；修正公开代码额外减去滞后收盘价的错误；采用其公开说明公式(C−C.shift(12))/ATR26。；原目录：VBM（roc_period=12, atr_period=26）；追踪：PF00983；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。 | `open_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`high_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`low_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`close_hfq`（`stock_day`） | 可独立实现；字段设计支持；本次恢复／锁定本地参数与边界 | 按本行OHLCV建立单股票、日期升序的本地DataFrame；volume=vol×100，价格后复权。附录定义了完整本地TA类及全部依赖，不导入FinTA。调用TA.VBM(ohlc,**{'roc_period': 12, 'atr_period': 26, 'column': 'close'})，Series视为一列；DataFrame只选择第0列，列名必须是'VBM'，最后按原日期reindex。修正公开代码额外减去滞后收盘价的错误；采用其公开说明公式(C−C.shift(12))/ATR26。每次调用传入copy，避免源方法修改调用方输入；iteritems改items，pct_change禁止隐式前填。；完整独立数值定义见[数值核 kernel_4ef42a01d8f63c34](#kernel_4ef42a01d8f63c34)；调用契约={"root_function":"TA.VBM","parameters":{"roc_period":12,"atr_period":26,"column":"close"},"output_index":0,"output_label":"VBM"}。；执行R1–R7；建议文件：factors/momentum/finta_vbm_vbm_12_26d.py。 | 动量 (momentum) |
| finta_rsi_14d | 固定公开源码默认参数：{'period': 14, 'column': 'close', 'adjust': True}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：RSI(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=14, column: str='close', adjust: bool=True): delta = ohlc[column].diff()<br>up, down = (delta.copy(), delta.copy())<br>up[up &lt; 0] = 0<br>down[down &gt; 0] = 0<br>_gain = up.ewm(alpha=1.0 / period, adjust=adjust).mean()<br>_loss = down.abs().ewm(alpha=1.0 / period, adjust=adjust).mean()<br>RS = _gain / _loss<br>return pd.Series(100 - 100 / (1 + RS), name='{0} period RSI'.format(period))；原目录：RSI（period=14）；追踪：PF00984；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。 | `open_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`high_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`low_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`close_hfq`（`stock_day`） | 可独立实现；字段设计支持；既有已核定定义 | 逐symbol建立本地OHLCV临时表，O/H/L/C后复权，volume以股计；按本列完整函数与依赖用NumPy/Pandas独立实现，cls./TA.方法调用改为同文件普通数值函数，不导入FinTA。保留每次ewm的adjust/min_periods参数及递推初始化；最后仅返回本方法单列Series，去掉name等展示元数据。旧.iteritems()改为.items()；pct_change显式fill_method=None；KAMA专属平价退化规则及种子以KAMA行的实现方法为准；DYMI返回索引不足整段时按原日期reindex到完整索引，首14行缺失，不改变后续数值。累计和/自适应状态使用全部已知历史，alld不设伪造固定日窗。；执行R1–R7；建议文件：factors/reversal/finta_rsi_14d.py。 | 反转 (reversal) |
| finta_ift_rsi_5_9d | 固定公开源码默认参数：{'column': 'close', 'rsi_period': 5, 'wma_period': 9}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：IFT_RSI(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, column: str='close', rsi_period: int=5, wma_period: int=9): v1 = pd.Series(0.1 * (cls.RSI(ohlc, rsi_period) - 50), name='v1')<br>d = wma_period * (wma_period + 1) / 2<br>weights = np.arange(1, wma_period + 1)<br>def linear(w):<br><br>    def _compute(x):<br>        return (w * x).sum() / d<br>    return _compute<br>_wma = v1.rolling(wma_period, min_periods=wma_period)<br>v2 = _wma.apply(linear(weights), raw=True)<br>ift = pd.Series((v2 ** 2 - 1) / (v2 ** 2 + 1), name='IFT_RSI')<br>return ift；RSI(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=14, column: str='close', adjust: bool=True): delta = ohlc[column].diff()<br>up, down = (delta.copy(), delta.copy())<br>up[up &lt; 0] = 0<br>down[down &gt; 0] = 0<br>_gain = up.ewm(alpha=1.0 / period, adjust=adjust).mean()<br>_loss = down.abs().ewm(alpha=1.0 / period, adjust=adjust).mean()<br>RS = _gain / _loss<br>return pd.Series(100 - 100 / (1 + RS), name='{0} period RSI'.format(period))；原目录：IFT_RSI（rsi_period=5, wma_period=9）；追踪：PF00985；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。 | `open_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`high_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`low_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`close_hfq`（`stock_day`） | 可独立实现；字段设计支持；既有已核定定义 | 逐symbol建立本地OHLCV临时表，O/H/L/C后复权，volume以股计；按本列完整函数与依赖用NumPy/Pandas独立实现，cls./TA.方法调用改为同文件普通数值函数，不导入FinTA。保留每次ewm的adjust/min_periods参数及递推初始化；最后仅返回本方法单列Series，去掉name等展示元数据。旧.iteritems()改为.items()；pct_change显式fill_method=None；KAMA专属平价退化规则及种子以KAMA行的实现方法为准；DYMI返回索引不足整段时按原日期reindex到完整索引，首14行缺失，不改变后续数值。累计和/自适应状态使用全部已知历史，alld不设伪造固定日窗。；执行R1–R7；建议文件：factors/reversal/finta_ift_rsi_5_9d.py。 | 反转 (reversal) |
| finta_dymi_5_10_14_30d | 固定公开源码默认参数：{'column': 'close', 'adjust': True}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：DYMI(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, column: str='close', adjust: bool=True): def _get_time(close):<br>    sd = close.rolling(5).std()<br>    asd = sd.rolling(10).mean()<br>    v = sd / asd<br>    t = 14 / v.round()<br>    t[t.isna()] = 0<br>    t = t.map(lambda x: int(min(max(x, 5), 30)))<br>    return t<br>def _dmi(index):<br>    time = t.iloc[index]<br>    if index - time &lt; 0:<br>        subset = ohlc.iloc[0:index]<br>    else:<br>        subset = ohlc.iloc[index - time:index]<br>    return cls.RSI(subset, period=time, adjust=adjust).values[-1]<br>dates = Series(ohlc.index)<br>periods = Series(range(14, len(dates)), index=ohlc.index[14:].values)<br>t = _get_time(ohlc[column])<br>return periods.map(lambda x: _dmi(x))；RSI(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=14, column: str='close', adjust: bool=True): delta = ohlc[column].diff()<br>up, down = (delta.copy(), delta.copy())<br>up[up &lt; 0] = 0<br>down[down &gt; 0] = 0<br>_gain = up.ewm(alpha=1.0 / period, adjust=adjust).mean()<br>_loss = down.abs().ewm(alpha=1.0 / period, adjust=adjust).mean()<br>RS = _gain / _loss<br>return pd.Series(100 - 100 / (1 + RS), name='{0} period RSI'.format(period))；原目录：DYMI（无固定窗口）；追踪：PF00986；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。 | `open_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`high_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`low_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`close_hfq`（`stock_day`） | 可独立实现；字段设计支持；既有已核定定义 | 逐symbol建立本地OHLCV临时表，O/H/L/C后复权，volume以股计；按本列完整函数与依赖用NumPy/Pandas独立实现，cls./TA.方法调用改为同文件普通数值函数，不导入FinTA。保留每次ewm的adjust/min_periods参数及递推初始化；最后仅返回本方法单列Series，去掉name等展示元数据。旧.iteritems()改为.items()；pct_change显式fill_method=None；KAMA专属平价退化规则及种子以KAMA行的实现方法为准；DYMI返回索引不足整段时按原日期reindex到完整索引，首14行缺失，不改变后续数值。累计和/自适应状态使用全部已知历史，alld不设伪造固定日窗。；执行R1–R7；建议文件：factors/reversal/finta_dymi_5_10_14_30d.py。 | 反转 (reversal) |

row['down_move'] and row['up_move'] &gt; 0:<br>        return row['up_move']<br>    else:<br>        return 0<br>def _dmn(row):<br>    if row['down_move'] &gt; row['up_move'] and row['down_move'] &gt; 0:<br>        return row['down_move']<br>    else:<br>        return 0<br>ohlc['plus'] = ohlc.apply(_dmp, axis=1)<br>ohlc['minus'] = ohlc.apply(_dmn, axis=1)<br>diplus = pd.Series(100 * (ohlc['plus'] / cls.ATR(ohlc, period)).ewm(alpha=1 / period, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='DI+')<br>diminus = pd.Series(100 * (ohlc['minus'] / cls.ATR(ohlc, period)).ewm(alpha=1 / period, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='DI-')<br>return pd.concat([diplus, diminus], axis=1)；ATR(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=14): TR = cls.TR(ohlc)<br>return pd.Series(TR.rolling(center=False, window=period).mean(), name='{0} period ATR'.format(period))；TR(cls, ohlc: DataFrame): TR1 = pd.Series(ohlc['high'] - ohlc['low']).abs()<br>TR2 = pd.Series(ohlc['high'] - ohlc['close'].shift()).abs()<br>TR3 = pd.Series(ohlc['close'].shift() - ohlc['low']).abs()<br>_TR = pd.concat([TR1, TR2, TR3], axis=1)<br>_TR['TR'] = _TR.max(axis=1)<br>return pd.Series(_TR['TR'], name='TR')；原目录：ADX（period=14）；追踪：PF00997；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。 | `open_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`high_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`low_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`close_hfq`（`stock_day`） | 可独立实现；字段设计支持；既有已核定定义 | 逐symbol建立本地OHLCV临时表，O/H/L/C后复权，volume以股计；按本列完整函数与依赖用NumPy/Pandas独立实现，cls./TA.方法调用改为同文件普通数值函数，不导入FinTA。保留每次ewm的adjust/min_periods参数及递推初始化；最后仅返回本方法单列Series，去掉name等展示元数据。旧.iteritems()改为.items()；pct_change显式fill_method=None；KAMA专属平价退化规则及种子以KAMA行的实现方法为准；DYMI返回索引不足整段时按原日期reindex到完整索引，首14行缺失，不改变后续数值。累计和/自适应状态使用全部已知历史，alld不设伪造固定日窗。；执行R1–R7；建议文件：factors/momentum/finta_adx_14d.py。 | 动量 (momentum) |

| finta_stochd_3_14d | 固定公开源码默认参数：{'period': 3, 'stoch_period': 14}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：STOCHD(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=3, stoch_period: int=14): return pd.Series(cls.STOCH(ohlc, stoch_period).rolling(center=False, window=period).mean(), name='{0} period STOCH %D.'.format(period))；STOCH(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=14): highest_high = ohlc['high'].rolling(center=False, window=period).max()<br>lowest_low = ohlc['low'].rolling(center=False, window=period).min()<br>STOCH = pd.Series((ohlc['close'] - lowest_low) / (highest_high - lowest_low) * 100, name='{0} period STOCH %K'.format(period))<br>return STOCH；原目录：STOCHD（period=3, stoch_period=14）；追踪：PF01000；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。 | `open_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`high_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`low_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`close_hfq`（`stock_day`） | 可独立实现；字段设计支持；既有已核定定义 | 逐symbol建立本地OHLCV临时表，O/H/L/C后复权，volume以股计；按本列完整函数与依赖用NumPy/Pandas独立实现，cls./TA.方法调用改为同文件普通数值函数，不导入FinTA。保留每次ewm的adjust/min_periods参数及递推初始化；最后仅返回本方法单列Series，去掉name等展示元数据。旧.iteritems()改为.items()；pct_change显式fill_method=None；KAMA专属平价退化规则及种子以KAMA行的实现方法为准；DYMI返回索引不足整段时按原日期reindex到完整索引，首14行缺失，不改变后续数值。累计和/自适应状态使用全部已知历史，alld不设伪造固定日窗。；执行R1–R7；建议文件：factors/reversal/finta_stochd_3_14d.py。 | 反转 (reversal) |
| finta_stochrsi_14_period_rsi_14_14_14d | (RSI−min(RSI,n))/(max(RSI,n)−min(RSI,n))，再按K/D窗口平滑；是否乘100按来源；确切输出列/初始化见[源码](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta/blob/af01fa594995de78f5ada5c336e61cd87c46b151/finta/finta.py#L1228)。；固定默认参数={'rsi_period': 14, 'stoch_period': 14}；实际单列输出='14 period RSI'；修正全样本RSI极值造成的未来依赖：极值仅取过去14个RSI；保留原代码最后14期均值平滑。此为明确修正版，不冒充原包逐值结果。；原目录：STOCHRSI（rsi_period=14, stoch_period=14）；追踪：PF01001；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。 | `open_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`high_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`low_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`close_hfq`（`stock_day`） | 可独立实现；字段设计支持；本次恢复／锁定本地参数与边界 | 按本行OHLCV建立单股票、日期升序的本地DataFrame；volume=vol×100，价格后复权。附录定义了完整本地TA类及全部依赖，不导入FinTA。调用TA.STOCHRSI(ohlc,**{'rsi_period': 14, 'stoch_period': 14})，Series视为一列；DataFrame只选择第0列，列名必须是'14 period RSI'，最后按原日期reindex。修正全样本RSI极值造成的未来依赖：极值仅取过去14个RSI；保留原代码最后14期均值平滑。此为明确修正版，不冒充原包逐值结果。每次调用传入copy，避免源方法修改调用方输入；iteritems改items，pct_change禁止隐式前填。；完整独立数值定义见[数值核 kernel_5ef5d3afc4ae8ab1](#kernel_5ef5d3afc4ae8ab1)；调用契约={"root_function":"TA.STOCHRSI","parameters":{"rsi_period":14,"stoch_period":14},"output_index":0,"output_label":"14 period RSI"}。；执行R1–R7；建议文件：factors/reversal/finta_stochrsi_14_period_rsi_14_14_14d.py。 | 反转 (reversal) |
| finta_uo_7_14_28d | 固定公开源码默认参数：{'column': 'close'}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：UO(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, column: str='close'): k = []<br>for row, _row in zip(ohlc.itertuples(), ohlc.shift(1).itertuples()):<br>    k.append(min(row.low, _row.close))<br>bp = pd.Series(ohlc[column] - k, name='bp')<br>Average7 = bp.rolling(window=7).sum() / cls.TR(ohlc).rolling(window=7).sum()<br>Average14 = bp.rolling(window=14).sum() / cls.TR(ohlc).rolling(window=14).sum()<br>Average28 = bp.rolling(window=28).sum() / cls.TR(ohlc).rolling(window=28).sum()<br>return pd.Series(100 * (4 * Average7 + 2 * Average14 + Average28) / (4 + 2 + 1))；TR(cls, ohlc: DataFrame): TR1 = pd.Series(ohlc['high'] - ohlc['low']).abs()<br>TR2 = pd.Series(ohlc['high'] - ohlc['close'].shift()).abs()<br>TR3 = pd.Series(ohlc['close'].shift() - ohlc['low']).abs()<br>_TR = pd.concat([TR1, TR2, TR3], axis=1)<br>_TR['TR'] = _TR.max(axis=1)<br>return pd.Series(_TR['TR'], name='TR')；原目录：UO（无固定窗口）；追踪：PF01002；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。 | `open_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`high_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`low_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`close_hfq`（`stock_day`） | 可独立实现；字段设计支持；既有已核定定义 | 逐symbol建立本地OHLCV临时表，O/H/L/C后复权，volume以股计；按本列完整函数与依赖用NumPy/Pandas独立实现，cls./TA.方法调用改为同文件普通数值函数，不导入FinTA。保留每次ewm的adjust/min_periods参数及递推初始化；最后仅返回本方法单列Series，去掉name等展示元数据。旧.iteritems()改为.items()；pct_change显式fill_method=None；KAMA专属平价退化规则及种子以KAMA行的实现方法为准；DYMI返回索引不足整段时按原日期reindex到完整索引，首14行缺失，不改变后续数值。累计和/自适应状态使用全部已知历史，alld不设伪造固定日窗。；执行R1–R7；建议文件：factors/reversal/finta_uo_7_14_28d.py。 | 反转 (reversal) |

| finta_cmo_9d | 固定公开源码默认参数：{'period': 9, 'factor': 100, 'column': 'close', 'adjust': True}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：CMO(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=9, factor: int=100, column: str='close', adjust: bool=True): delta = ohlc[column].diff()<br>up, down = (delta.copy(), delta.copy())<br>up[up &lt; 0] = 0<br>down[down &gt; 0] = 0<br>_gain = up.ewm(com=period, adjust=adjust).mean()<br>_loss = down.ewm(com=period, adjust=adjust).mean().abs()<br>return pd.Series(factor * ((_gain - _loss) / (_gain + _loss)), name='CMO')；原目录：CMO（period=9, factor=100）；追踪：PF01020；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。 | `open_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`high_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`low_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`close_hfq`（`stock_day`） | 可独立实现；字段设计支持；既有已核定定义 | 逐symbol建立本地OHLCV临时表，O/H/L/C后复权，volume以股计；按本列完整函数与依赖用NumPy/Pandas独立实现，cls./TA.方法调用改为同文件普通数值函数，不导入FinTA。保留每次ewm的adjust/min_periods参数及递推初始化；最后仅返回本方法单列Series，去掉name等展示元数据。旧.iteritems()改为.items()；pct_change显式fill_method=None；KAMA专属平价退化规则及种子以KAMA行的实现方法为准；DYMI返回索引不足整段时按原日期reindex到完整索引，首14行缺失，不改变后续数值。累计和/自适应状态使用全部已知历史，alld不设伪造固定日窗。；执行R1–R7；建议文件：factors/reversal/finta_cmo_9d.py。 | 反转 (reversal) |

| finta_fish_10d | 固定公开源码默认参数：{'period': 10, 'adjust': True}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：FISH(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=10, adjust: bool=True): from numpy import log, seterr<br>seterr(divide='ignore')<br>med = (ohlc['high'] + ohlc['low']) / 2<br>ndaylow = med.rolling(window=period).min()<br>ndayhigh = med.rolling(window=period).max()<br>raw = 2 * ((med - ndaylow) / (ndayhigh - ndaylow)) - 1<br>smooth = raw.ewm(span=5, adjust=adjust).mean()<br>_smooth = smooth.fillna(0)<br>return pd.Series(log((1 + _smooth) / (1 - _smooth)).ewm(span=3, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='{0} period FISH.'.format(period))；原目录：FISH（period=10）；追踪：PF01024；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。 | `open_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`high_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`low_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`close_hfq`（`stock_day`） | 可独立实现；字段设计支持；既有已核定定义 | 逐symbol建立本地OHLCV临时表，O/H/L/C后复权，volume以股计；按本列完整函数与依赖用NumPy/Pandas独立实现，cls./TA.方法调用改为同文件普通数值函数，不导入FinTA。保留每次ewm的adjust/min_periods参数及递推初始化；最后仅返回本方法单列Series，去掉name等展示元数据。旧.iteritems()改为.items()；pct_change显式fill_method=None；KAMA专属平价退化规则及种子以KAMA行的实现方法为准；DYMI返回索引不足整段时按原日期reindex到完整索引，首14行缺失，不改变后续数值。累计和/自适应状态使用全部已知历史，alld不设伪造固定日窗。；执行R1–R7；建议文件：factors/reversal/finta_fish_10d.py。 | 反转 (reversal) |

kc_mult * cls.ATR(ohlc, atr_period), name='KC_LOWER')<br>return pd.concat([up, down], axis=1)；SMA(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=41, column: str='close'): return pd.Series(ohlc[column].rolling(window=period).mean(), name='{0} period SMA'.format(period))；EMA(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=9, column: str='close', adjust: bool=True): return pd.Series(ohlc[column].ewm(span=period, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='{0} period EMA'.format(period))；ATR(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=14): TR = cls.TR(ohlc)<br>return pd.Series(TR.rolling(center=False, window=period).mean(), name='{0} period ATR'.format(period))；TR(cls, ohlc: DataFrame): TR1 = pd.Series(ohlc['high'] - | finta_vfi_130d | 固定公开源码默认参数：{'period': 130, 'smoothing_factor': 3, 'factor': 0.2, 'vfactor': 2.5, 'adjust': True}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：VFI(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=130, smoothing_factor: int=3, factor: int=0.2, vfactor: int=2.5, adjust: bool=True): typical = TA.TP(ohlc)<br>inter = typical.apply(np.log).diff()<br>vinter = inter.rolling(window=30).std()<br>cutoff = pd.Series(factor * vinter * ohlc['close'], name='cutoff')<br>price_change = pd.Series(typical.diff(), name='pc')<br>mav = pd.Series(ohlc['volume'].rolling(center=False, window=period).mean(), name='mav')<br>_va = pd.concat([ohlc['volume'], mav.shift()], axis=1)<br>_mp = pd.concat([price_change, cutoff], axis=1)<br>_mp.fillna(value=0, inplace=True)<br>def _vol_added(row):<br>    """ Determine the maximum volume to be added"""<br>    if row['volume'] &gt; vfactor * row['mav']:<br>        return vfactor * row['mav']<br>    else:<br>        return row['volume']<br>added_vol = _va.apply(_vol_added, axis=1)<br>def _multiplier(row):<br>    """<br>            Determine whether the volume is up volume (multiplier +1) or<br>            down volume (multiplier -1). | finta_evstc_12_30_10_3d | 固定公开源码默认参数：{'period_fast': 12, 'period_slow': 30, 'k_period': 10, 'd_period': 3, 'adjust': True}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：EVSTC(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period_fast: int=12, period_slow: int=30, k_period: int=10, d_period: int=3, adjust: bool=True): ema_slow = cls.EVWMA(ohlc, period_slow)<br>ema_fast = cls.EVWMA(ohlc, period_fast)<br>macd = ema_fast - ema_slow<br>STOK = pd.Series((macd - macd.rolling(window=k_period).min()) / (macd.rolling(window=k_period).max() - macd.rolling(window=k_period).min()) * 100)<br>STOD = STOK.rolling(window=d_period).mean()<br>STOD_DoubleSmooth = STOD.rolling(window=d_period).mean()<br>return pd.Series(STOD_DoubleSmooth, name='{0} period EVSTC'.format(k_period))；EVWMA(cls, ohlcv: DataFrame, period: int=20): vol_sum = ohlcv['volume'].rolling(window=period).sum()<br>x = (vol_sum - ohlcv['volume']) / vol_sum<br>y = ohlcv['volume'] * ohlcv['close'] / vol_sum<br>evwma = [0]<br>for x, y in zip(x.fillna(0).iteritems(), y.iteritems()):<br>    if x[1] == 0 or y[1] == 0:<br>        evwma.append(0)<br>    else:<br>        evwma.append(evwma[-1] * x[1] + y[1])<br>return pd.Series(evwma[1:], index=ohlcv.index, name='{0} period EVWMA.'.format(period))；原目录：EVSTC（period_fast=12, period_slow=30, k_period=10, d_period=3）；追踪：PF01033；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。 | `open_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`high_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`low_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`close_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`vol`（`stock_day`） | 可独立实现；字段设计支持；既有已核定定义 | 逐symbol建立本地OHLCV临时表，O/H/L/C后复权，volume以股计；按本列完整函数与依赖用NumPy/Pandas独立实现，cls./TA.方法调用改为同文件普通数值函数，不导入FinTA。保留每次ewm的adjust/min_periods参数及递推初始化；最后仅返回本方法单列Series，去掉name等展示元数据。旧.iteritems()改为.items()；pct_change显式fill_method=None；KAMA专属平价退化规则及种子以KAMA行的实现方法为准；DYMI返回索引不足整段时按原日期reindex到完整索引，首14行缺失，不改变后续数值。累计和/自适应状态使用全部已知历史，alld不设伪造固定日窗。；执行R1–R7；建议文件：factors/reversal/finta_evstc_12_30_10_3d.py。 | 反转 (reversal) |

| finta_wavepm_14_100d | 固定公开源码默认参数：{'period': 14, 'lookback_period': 100, 'column': 'close'}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：WAVEPM(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=14, lookback_period: int=100, column: str='close'): ma = ohlc[column].rolling(window=period).mean()<br>std = ohlc[column].rolling(window=period).std(ddof=0)<br>def tanh(x):<br>    two = np.where(x &gt; 0, -2, 2)<br>    what = two * x<br>    ex = np.exp(what)<br>    j = 1 - ex<br>    k = ex - 1<br>    l = np.where(x &gt; 0, j, k)<br>    output = l / (1 + ex)<br>    return output<br>def osc(input_dev, mean, power):<br>    variance = Series(power).rolling(window=lookback_period).sum() / lookback_period<br>    calc_dev = np.sqrt(variance) * mean<br>    y = input_dev / calc_dev<br>    oscLine = tanh(y)<br>    return oscLine<br>dev = 3.2 * std<br>power = np.power(dev / ma, 2)<br>wavepm = osc(dev, ma, power)<br>return pd.Series(wavepm, name='{0} period WAVEPM'.format(period))；原目录：WAVEPM（period=14, lookback_period=100）；追踪：PF01036；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。 | `open_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`high_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`low_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`close_hfq`（`stock_day`） | 可独立实现；字段设计支持；既有已核定定义 | 逐symbol建立本地OHLCV临时表，O/H/L/C后复权，volume以股计；按本列完整函数与依赖用NumPy/Pandas独立实现，cls./TA.方法调用改为同文件普通数值函数，不导入FinTA。保留每次ewm的adjust/min_periods参数及递推初始化；最后仅返回本方法单列Series，去掉name等展示元数据。旧.iteritems()改为.items()；pct_change显式fill_method=None；KAMA专属平价退化规则及种子以KAMA行的实现方法为准；DYMI返回索引不足整段时按原日期reindex到完整索引，首14行缺失，不改变后续数值。累计和/自适应状态使用全部已知历史，alld不设伪造固定日窗。；执行R1–R7；建议文件：factors/risk/finta_wavepm_14_100d.py。 | 风险 (risk) |

### Tulip Indicators｜[来源](https://github.com/TulipCharts/tulipindicators/blob/be18abb13e075ba866898dcc7cb52399603302a6/indicators.h)｜独立可实现因子数：54

| 因子名称 | 公式定义 | 所需字段（来源表） | 支持情况 | 实现方法 | 类别 |

| ptac_lrsi_lrsi_14_14d | 源码算子/递推链：输出=(l0, l1, l2, l3)；l0[i] = (1 - gamma) * c_arr[i] + gamma * l0[i - 1]；l1[i] = -gamma * l0[i] + l0[i - 1] + gamma * l1[i - 1]；l2[i] = -gamma * l1[i] + l1[i - 1] + gamma * l2[i - 1]；l3[i] = -gamma * l2[i] + l2[i - 1] + gamma * l3[i - 1]；源码算子/递推链：cu += maximum(l0 - l1, 0)；cd += maximum(l1 - l0, 0)；cu += maximum(l1 - l2, 0)；cd += maximum(l2 - l1, 0)；cu += maximum(l2 - l3, 0)；cd += maximum(l3 - l2, 0)；denominator = cu + cd；lrsi = Series(100 * cu / denominator, index=close.index)；输出=lrsi；输出=None；[完整算法/输出列](https://github.com/xgboosted/pandas-ta-classic/blob/74e91a71b56e12ef17a47de42e601d19573ee0fb/pandas_ta_classic/momentum/lrsi.py#L29)；完整独立Python定义见本行实现方法指定的数值核；有效参数={'length': 14, 'gamma': 0.5, 'offset': 0}；只输出'LRSI_14'；原目录：lrsi（length=14）；追踪：PF01193；[来源](https://github.com/xgboosted/pandas-ta-classic)。 | `close_hfq`（`stock_day`） | 可独立实现；字段设计支持；本次恢复／锁定本地参数与边界 | 按本行字段构造同索引的逐股Series；open_/open均绑定open_hfq，其他价格后复权，volume=vol×100。数值核已展开函数及每个源内辅助函数，保留实际数学分支，删除可选TA-Lib/Tulipy后端，移除仅用于包接口的装饰器，不依赖Pandas TA安装。用root_function调用，输入实参顺序/名称及supplied_parameters由调用契约明确给出；不得填充原始缺失值、不得启用lookahead、offset固定0。Series视为一列，DataFrame仅取output_index对应且列名等于output_label的一列。；完整独立数值定义见[数值核 kernel_7d62725df3b3fb17](#kernel_7d62725df3b3fb17)；调用契约={"root_function":"f_218dc74888_lrsi","required_inputs":["close"],"parameters":{"length":14,"gamma":0.5,"offset":0},"supplied_parameters":{"talib":false,"lookahead":false,"offset":0},"output_index":0,"output_label":"LRSI_14","gate_bars":1}。；执行R1–R7；建议文件：factors/momentum/ptac_lrsi_lrsi_14_14d.py。 | 动量 (momentum) |

| ptac_vfi_vfi_130_130d | 源码算子/递推链：_length = max(length, _VINTER_LENGTH) + 1；inter = log(typical).diff().to_numpy(dtype=float)；cutoff = coef * vinter * close.to_numpy(dtype=float)；vave = volume.rolling(length).mean().shift(1)；vc = minimum(volume.to_numpy(dtype=float), vave.to_numpy(dtype=float) * vcoef)；mf = typical.diff().to_numpy(dtype=float)；vcp = where(mf &gt; cutoff, vc, where(mf &lt; -cutoff, -vc, 0.0))；vfi = degenerate_div(vcp.rolling(length).sum(), vave)；输出=vfi；输出=None；vinter[_VINTER_LENGTH - 1:] = lib.stride_tricks.sliding_window_view(inter, _VINTER_LENGTH).std(axis=1)；[完整算法/输出列](https://github.com/xgboosted/pandas-ta-classic/blob/74e91a71b56e12ef17a47de42e601d19573ee0fb/pandas_ta_classic/volume/vfi.py#L17)；完整独立Python定义见本行实现方法指定的数值核；有效参数={'length': 130, 'coef': 0.2, 'vcoef': 2.5, 'mamode': 'ema', 'offset': 0}；只输出'VFI_130'；原目录：vfi（length=130, mamode='ema'）；追踪：PF01323；[来源](https://github.com/xgboosted/pandas-ta-classic)。 | `high_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`low_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`close_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`vol`（`stock_day`） | 可独立实现；字段设计支持；本次恢复／锁定本地参数与边界 | 按本行字段构造同索引的逐股Series；open_/open均绑定open_hfq，其他价格后复权，volume=vol×100。数值核已展开函数及每个源内辅助函数，保留实际数学分支，删除可选TA-Lib/Tulipy后端，移除仅用于包接口的装饰器，不依赖Pandas TA安装。用root_function调用，输入实参顺序/名称及supplied_parameters由调用契约明确给出；不得填充原始缺失值、不得启用lookahead、offset固定0。Series视为一列，DataFrame仅取output_index对应且列名等于output_label的一列。；完整独立数值定义见[数值核 kernel_4a5fa844310784d8](#kernel_4a5fa844310784d8)；调用契约={"root_function":"f_739b2dea6d_vfi","required_inputs":["high","low","close","volume"],"parameters":{"length":130,"coef":0.2,"vcoef":2.5,"mamode":"ema","offset":0},"supplied_parameters":{"talib":false,"lookahead":false,"offset":0},"output_index":0,"output_label":"VFI_130","gate_bars":1}。；执行R1–R7；建议文件：factors/volume_price/ptac_vfi_vfi_130_130d.py。 | 量价 (volume_price) |

| stockstats_rsi_14d | 完整数值定义（逐股数组/Series算法，仅返回meta.name对应的主列）：参数meta.window=14，meta.column=close，meta.as_int/int0/int1按固定窗口取值；固定类常量={}；_get_rsi(self, meta: _Meta): self[meta.name] = self._rsi(meta.as_int)；_rsi(self, window): close = self.close.values<br>diff = self._np_diff(close)<br>up = np.where(diff &gt; 0, diff, 0.0)<br>down = np.where(diff &lt; 0, -diff, 0.0)<br>up_sma = self.smma(pd.Series(up), window).values<br>down_sma = self.smma(pd.Series(down), window).values<br>total_chg = up_sma + down_sma<br>with np.errstate(divide='ignore', invalid='ignore'):<br>    rsi = np.where(total_chg != 0, 100 * (up_sma / total_chg), 50.0)<br>rsi[0] = 50.0<br>return self.to_series(rsi)；_np_diff(arr: np.ndarray): diff = np.zeros_like(arr)<br>diff[1:] = np.diff(arr)<br>return diff；to_series(self, arr: Union[list, np.ndarray]): return pd.Series(arr, index=self.close.index).fillna(0)；smma(series, window): return series.ewm(ignore_na=False, alpha=1.0 / window, min_periods=0, adjust=True).mean()；原目录：rsi（窗口=14）；追踪：PF01474；[来源](https://github.com/jealous/stockstats)。 | `close_hfq`（`stock_day`） | 可独立实现；字段设计支持；既有已核定定义 | 按本列已展开的_get方法和辅助算子移植到独立局部数组；self.close/high/low/open/volume绑定本行声明字段，to_series只恢复同一日期索引，meta.name是唯一返回因子，name_ex产生的信号线仅作中间量。显式不向TP辅助函数传入amount列，固定HLC3分支；保留源码的平滑、种子、0/0和起始值处理，缺原始价格/成交量时该日仍缺失。不依赖StockDataFrame字符串自动计算或stockstats安装。；执行R1–R7；建议文件：factors/reversal/stockstats_rsi_14d.py。 | 反转 (reversal) |
| stockstats_stochrsi_14d | 完整数值定义（逐股数组/Series算法，仅返回meta.name对应的主列）：参数meta.window=14，meta.column=close，meta.as_int/int0/int1按固定窗口取值；固定类常量={}；_get_stochrsi(self, meta: _Meta): window = meta.as_int<br>rsi = self._rsi(window)<br>rsi_min = self.mov_min(rsi, window)<br>rsi_max = self.mov_max(rsi, window)<br>rsi_range = rsi_max - rsi_min<br>cv = np.where(rsi_range != 0, (rsi - rsi_min) / rsi_range, 0.0)<br>self[meta.name] = cv * 100；_rsi(self, window): close = self.close.values<br>diff = self._np_diff(close)<br>up = np.where(diff &gt; 0, diff, 0.0)<br>down = np.where(diff &lt; 0, -diff, 0.0)<br>up_sma = self.smma(pd.Series(up), window).values<br>down_sma = self.smma(pd.Series(down), window).values<br>total_chg = up_sma + down_sma<br>with np.errstate(divide='ignore', invalid='ignore'):<br>    rsi = np.where(total_chg != 0, 100 * (up_sma / total_chg), 50.0)<br>rsi[0] = 50.0<br>return self.to_series(rsi)；mov_min(cls, series, size): return cls._rolling(series, size).min()；mov_max(cls, series, size): return cls._rolling(series, size).max()；_np_diff(arr: np.ndarray): diff = np.zeros_like(arr)<br>diff[1:] = np.diff(arr)<br>return diff；to_series(self, arr: Union[list, np.ndarray]): return pd.Series(arr, index=self.close.index).fillna(0)；smma(series, window): return series.ewm(ignore_na=False, alpha=1.0 / window, min_periods=0, adjust=True).mean()；_rolling(series: pd.Series, window: int): return series.rolling(window, min_periods=1, center=False)；原目录：stochrsi（窗口=14）；追踪：PF01475；[来源](https://github.com/jealous/stockstats)。 | `close_hfq`（`stock_day`） | 可独立实现；字段设计支持；既有已核定定义 | 按本列已展开的_get方法和辅助算子移植到独立局部数组；self.close/high/low/open/volume绑定本行声明字段，to_series只恢复同一日期索引，meta.name是唯一返回因子，name_ex产生的信号线仅作中间量。显式不向TP辅助函数传入amount列，固定HLC3分支；保留源码的平滑、种子、0/0和起始值处理，缺原始价格/成交量时该日仍缺失。不依赖StockDataFrame字符串自动计算或stockstats安装。；执行R1–R7；建议文件：factors/reversal/stockstats_stochrsi_14d.py。 | 反转 (reversal) |

| stockstats_cr_26d | 完整定义为附录StockDataFrame中'cr'对应的_get_*方法及其全部内置算子；列名='cr'；全部类级默认参数已保留。源码算子/递推链：输出=to_series(tp)；tp = amount.values / volume.values；total = close.values + high.values + low.values；tp = total / 3.0；源码算子/递推链：输出=s_shift(cr_sma, -int(window / 2.5 + 1))；源码算子/递推链：输出=s_shift(cr_sma, -int(window / 2.5 + 1))；源码算子/递推链：输出=s_shift(cr_sma, -int(window / 2.5 + 1))；源码算子/递推链：last_middle = s_shift(middle, -1)；ym = s_shift(middle, -1)；p1 = mov_sum(high - p1_m, window)；p2 = mov_sum(ym - p2_m, window)；self[name] = cr = p1 / p2 * 100；self[f'{name}-ma1'] = _shifted_cr_sma(cr, CR_MA[0])；self[f'{name}-ma2'] = _shifted_cr_sma(cr, CR_MA[1])；self[f'{name}-ma3'] = _shifted_cr_sma(cr, CR_MA[2])；默认参数取源码_dft_windows/方法元数据；[源码](https://github.com/jealous/stockstats/blob/67318d90e2e051aeb7838b56feacf90747fd6635/stockstats.py#L943)；原目录：cr（窗口=26）；追踪：PF01486；[来源](https://github.com/jealous/stockstats)。；本地复权适配：均价在后复权尺度计算，输入核的等效成交额=amount×1000×adj_factor；因此核内amount/volume=(amount×1000)/(vol×100)×adj_factor。 | `open_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`high_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`low_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`close_hfq`（`stock_day`）；`vol`（`stock_day`）；`amount`（`stock_day`）；`adj_factor`（`stock_day`） | 可独立实现；字段设计支持；本次恢复／锁定本地参数与边界 | 把后复权OHLC、vol×100股、amount×1000元绑定为open/high/low/close/volume/amount，逐股建立日期升序DataFrame。附录给出可独立执行的全部本地类定义；不导入stockstats包。调用本地StockDataFrame.retype(df.copy())['cr']，只取这一列，按原日期对齐；不能把_get方法产生的其他辅助列也当本行输出。所有默认配置与辅助算子均已展开于同一核，按源中因果窗口执行。；完整独立数值定义见[数值核 kernel_34231470068a1530](#kernel_34231470068a1530)；调用契约={"root_function":"StockDataFrame.retype","parameters":{"column":"cr"},"output_index":0,"output_label":"cr"}。；执行R1–R7；建议文件：factors/volume_price/stockstats_cr_26d.py。；优先执行本行复权适配：amount传入等效成交额amount×1000×adj_factor，volume仍为vol×100；使核内_tp()与后复权OHLC同尺度。等效成交额仅用于本行价格型数值核，不作为原始实际成交额字段输出；不得将未复权A/V与后复权高低价直接比较。 | 量价 (volume_price) |

| <a id="kernel_07857876443d309c"></a>kernel_07857876443d309c；Python；入口：TA.BASPN；归属：FinTA | <pre><code>from __future__ import annotations<br>import numpy as np<br>import pandas as pd<br>from pandas import DataFrame,Series<br>class TA:<br>    @classmethod<br>    def BASPN(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=40, adjust: bool=True) -&gt; DataFrame:<br>        sp = ohlc['high'] - ohlc['close']<br>        bp = ohlc['close'] - ohlc['low']<br>        spavg = sp.ewm(span=period, adjust=adjust).mean()<br>        bpavg = bp.ewm(span=period, adjust=adjust).mean()<br>        nbp = bp / bpavg<br>        nsp = sp / spavg<br>        varg = ohlc['volume'].ewm(span=period, adjust=adjust).mean()<br>        nv = ohlc['volume'] / varg<br>        nbf = pd.Series((nbp * nv).ewm(span=20, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='Buy.')<br>        nsf = pd.Series((nsp * nv).ewm(span=20, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='Sell.')<br>        return pd.concat([nbf, nsf], axis=1)</code></pre> |

| <a id="kernel_0aef886897fc2b19"></a>kernel_0aef886897fc2b19；Python；入口：TA.EBBP；归属：FinTA | <pre><code>from __future__ import annotations<br>import numpy as np<br>import pandas as pd<br>from pandas import DataFrame,Series<br>class TA:<br>    @classmethod<br>    def EBBP(cls, ohlc: DataFrame) -&gt; DataFrame:<br>        bull_power = pd.Series(ohlc['high'] - cls.EMA(ohlc, 13), name='Bull.')<br>        bear_power = pd.Series(ohlc['low'] - cls.EMA(ohlc, 13), name='Bear.')<br>        return pd.concat([bull_power, bear_power], axis=1)<br>    @classmethod<br>    def EMA(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=9, column: str='close', adjust: bool=True) -&gt; Series:<br>        return pd.Series(ohlc[column].ewm(span=period, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='{0} period EMA'.format(period))</code></pre> |

| <a id="kernel_0c0d6a827334f674"></a>kernel_0c0d6a827334f674；C；入口：ti_obv；归属：Tulip Indicators | <pre><code>#include &lt;math.h&gt;<br>#include &lt;stdlib.h&gt;<br>#include &lt;string.h&gt;<br>typedef struct {int size,pushes,index; double sum; double vals[1];} ti_buffer;<br><br>int ti_obv_start(double const *options);<br>int ti_obv(int size, double const *const *inputs, double const *options, double *const *outputs);<br>int ti_obv_start(double const *options) {<br>    (void)options;<br>    return 0;<br>}<br>int ti_obv(int size, double const *const *inputs, double const *options, double *const *outputs) {<br>    const double *close = inputs[0];<br>    const double *volume = inputs[1];<br>    (void)options;<br>    double *output = outputs[0];<br>    double sum = 0;<br>    *output++ = sum;<br>    double prev = close[0];<br>    int i;<br>    for (i = 1; i &lt; size; ++i) {<br>        if (close[i] &gt; prev) {<br>            sum += volume[i];<br>        } else if (close[i] &lt; prev) {<br>            sum -= volume[i];<br>        } else {<br>        }<br>        prev = close[i];<br>        *output++ = sum;<br>    }<br>    return 0;<br>}</code></pre> |
| <a id="kernel_0d9a26ca22a621b2"></a>kernel_0d9a26ca22a621b2；Python；入口：TA.DMI；归属：FinTA | <pre><code>from __future__ import annotations<br>import numpy as np<br>import pandas as pd<br>from pandas import DataFrame,Series<br>class TA:<br>    @classmethod<br>    def DMI(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=14, adjust: bool=True) -&gt; DataFrame:<br>        ohlc['up_move'] = ohlc['high'].diff()<br>        ohlc['down_move'] = -ohlc['low'].diff()<br>    <br>        def _dmp(row):<br>            if row['up_move'] &gt; row['down_move'] and row['up_move'] &gt; 0:<br>                return row['up_move']<br>            else:<br>                return 0<br>    <br>        def _dmn(row):<br>            if row['down_move'] &gt; row['up_move'] and row['down_move'] &gt; 0:<br>                return row['down_move']<br>            else:<br>                return 0<br>        ohlc['plus'] = ohlc.apply(_dmp, axis=1)<br>        ohlc['minus'] = ohlc.apply(_dmn, axis=1)<br>        diplus = pd.Series(100 * (ohlc['plus'] / cls.ATR(ohlc, period)).ewm(alpha=1 / period, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='DI+')<br>        diminus = pd.Series(100 * (ohlc['minus'] / cls.ATR(ohlc, period)).ewm(alpha=1 / period, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='DI-')<br>        return pd.concat([diplus, diminus], axis=1)<br>    @classmethod<br>    def ATR(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=14) -&gt; Series:<br>        TR = cls.TR(ohlc)<br>        return pd.Series(TR.rolling(center=False, window=period).mean(), name='{0} period ATR'.format(period))<br>    @classmethod<br>    def TR(cls, ohlc: DataFrame) -&gt; Series:<br>        TR1 = pd.Series(ohlc['high'] - ohlc['low']).abs()<br>        TR2 = pd.Series(ohlc['high'] - ohlc['close'].shift()).abs()<br>        TR3 = pd.Series(ohlc['close'].shift() - ohlc['low']).abs()<br>        _TR = pd.concat([TR1, TR2, TR3], axis=1)<br>        _TR['TR'] = _TR.max(axis=1)<br>        return pd.Series(_TR['TR'], name='TR')</code></pre> |
| <a id="kernel_0ddb77214ace39ae"></a>kernel_0ddb77214ace39ae；Python；入口：TA.BASP；归属：FinTA | <pre><code>from __future__ import annotations<br>import numpy as np<br>import pandas as pd<br>from pandas import DataFrame,Series<br>class TA:<br>    @classmethod<br>    def BASP(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=40, adjust: bool=True) -&gt; DataFrame:<br>        sp = ohlc['high'] - ohlc['close']<br>        bp = ohlc['close'] - ohlc['low']<br>        spavg = sp.ewm(span=period, adjust=adjust).mean()<br>        bpavg = bp.ewm(span=period, adjust=adjust).mean()<br>        nbp = bp / bpavg<br>        nsp = sp / spavg<br>        varg = ohlc['volume'].ewm(span=period, adjust=adjust).mean()<br>        nv = ohlc['volume'] / varg<br>        nbfraw = pd.Series(nbp * nv, name='Buy.')<br>        nsfraw = pd.Series(nsp * nv, name='Sell.')<br>        return pd.concat([nbfraw, nsfraw], axis=1)</code></pre> |
| <a id="kernel_0e3fbba1da15bc25"></a>kernel_0e3fbba1da15bc25；Python；入口：TA.MACD；归属：FinTA | <pre><code>from __future__ import annotations<br>import numpy as np<br>import pandas as pd<br>from pandas import DataFrame,Series<br>class TA:<br>    @classmethod<br>    def MACD(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period_fast: int=12, period_slow: int=26, signal: int=9, column: str='close', adjust: bool=True) -&gt; DataFrame:<br>        EMA_fast = pd.Series(ohlc[column].ewm(ignore_na=False, span=period_fast, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='EMA_fast')<br>        EMA_slow = pd.Series(ohlc[column].ewm(ignore_na=False, span=period_slow, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='EMA_slow')<br>        MACD = pd.Series(EMA_fast - EMA_slow, name='MACD')<br>        MACD_signal = pd.Series(MACD.ewm(ignore_na=False, span=signal, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='SIGNAL')<br>        return pd.concat([MACD, MACD_signal], axis=1)</code></pre> |

| <a id="kernel_2daedd7d871d8033"></a>kernel_2daedd7d871d8033；Python；入口：TA.PPO；归属：FinTA | <pre><code>from __future__ import annotations<br>import numpy as np<br>import pandas as pd<br>from pandas import DataFrame,Series<br>class TA:<br>    @classmethod<br>    def PPO(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period_fast: int=12, period_slow: int=26, signal: int=9, column: str='close', adjust: bool=True) -&gt; DataFrame:<br>        EMA_fast = pd.Series(ohlc[column].ewm(ignore_na=False, span=period_fast, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='EMA_fast')<br>        EMA_slow = pd.Series(ohlc[column].ewm(ignore_na=False, span=period_slow, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='EMA_slow')<br>        PPO = pd.Series((EMA_fast - EMA_slow) / EMA_slow * 100, name='PPO')<br>        PPO_signal = pd.Series(PPO.ewm(ignore_na=False, span=signal, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='SIGNAL')<br>        PPO_histo = pd.Series(PPO - PPO_signal, name='HISTO')<br>        return pd.concat([PPO, PPO_signal, PPO_histo], axis=1)</code></pre> |
| <a id="kernel_2db731d9f59352c4"></a>kernel_2db731d9f59352c4；Python；入口：pyti_standard_deviation_standard_deviation；归属：PyTI | <pre><code>import numpy as np<br>def pyti_standard_deviation_standard_deviation(data, period):<br>    pyti_catch_errors_check_for_period_error(data, period)<br>    stds = [ext_numpy_None.std(data[idx + 1 - period:idx + 1], ddof=1) for idx in range(period - 1, len(data))]<br>    stds = pyti_function_helper_fill_for_noncomputable_vals(data, stds)<br>    return stds<br><br>def pyti_catch_errors_check_for_period_error(data, period):<br>    period = int(period)<br>    data_len = len(data)<br>    if data_len &lt; period:<br>        raise ValueError('Error: data_len &lt; period')<br><br>import numpy as ext_numpy_None<br><br>def pyti_function_helper_fill_for_noncomputable_vals(input_data, result_data):<br>    non_computable_values = ext_numpy_None.repeat(ext_numpy_None.nan, len(input_data) - len(result_data))<br>    filled_result_data = ext_numpy_None.append(non_computable_values, result_data)<br>    return filled_result_data</code></pre> |
| <a id="kernel_2f0892620bf561b5"></a>kernel_2f0892620bf561b5；Python；入口：TA.WTO；归属：FinTA | <pre><code>from __future__ import annotations<br>import numpy as np<br>import pandas as pd<br>from pandas import DataFrame,Series<br>class TA:<br>    @classmethod<br>    def WTO(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, channel_length: int=10, average_length: int=21, adjust: bool=True) -&gt; DataFrame:<br>        ap = cls.TP(ohlc)<br>        esa = ap.ewm(span=average_length, adjust=adjust).mean()<br>        d = pd.Series((ap - esa).abs().ewm(span=channel_length, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='d')<br>        ci = (ap - esa) / (0.015 * d)<br>        wt1 = pd.Series(ci.ewm(span=average_length, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='WT1.')<br>        wt2 = pd.Series(wt1.rolling(window=4).mean(), name='WT2.')<br>        return pd.concat([wt1, wt2], axis=1)<br>    @classmethod<br>    def TP(cls, ohlc: DataFrame) -&gt; Series:<br>        return pd.Series((ohlc['high'] + ohlc['low'] + ohlc['close']) / 3, name='TP')</code></pre> |

| <a id="kernel_34ad41fd7cad2286"></a>kernel_34ad41fd7cad2286；Python；入口：TA.ICHIMOKU；归属：FinTA | <pre><code>from __future__ import annotations<br>import numpy as np<br>import pandas as pd<br>from pandas import DataFrame,Series<br>class TA:<br>    @classmethod<br>    def ICHIMOKU(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, tenkan_period: int=9, kijun_period: int=26, senkou_period: int=52, chikou_period: int=26) -&gt; DataFrame:<br>        tenkan_sen = pd.Series((ohlc['high'].rolling(window=tenkan_period).max() + ohlc['low'].rolling(window=tenkan_period).min()) / 2, name='TENKAN')<br>        kijun_sen = pd.Series((ohlc['high'].rolling(window=kijun_period).max() + ohlc['low'].rolling(window=kijun_period).min()) / 2, name='KIJUN')<br>        senkou_span_a = pd.Series((tenkan_sen + kijun_sen) / 2, name='senkou_span_a').shift(kijun_period)<br>        senkou_span_b = pd.Series((ohlc['high'].rolling(window=senkou_period).max() + ohlc['low'].rolling(window=senkou_period).min()) / 2, name='SENKOU').shift(kijun_period)<br>        chikou_span = pd.Series(np.nan,index=ohlc.index,name='CHIKOU')<br>        return pd.concat([tenkan_sen, kijun_sen, senkou_span_a, senkou_span_b, chikou_span], axis=1)</code></pre> |

| <a id="kernel_3f993d52484e2b63"></a>kernel_3f993d52484e2b63；Python；入口：TA.VC；归属：FinTA | <pre><code>from __future__ import annotations<br>import numpy as np<br>import pandas as pd<br>from pandas import DataFrame,Series<br>class TA:<br>    @classmethod<br>    def VC(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=5) -&gt; DataFrame:<br>        float_axis = ((ohlc.high + ohlc.low) / 2).rolling(window=period).mean()<br>        vol_unit = (ohlc.high - ohlc.low).rolling(window=period).mean() * 0.2<br>        value_chart_high = pd.Series((ohlc.high - float_axis) / vol_unit, name='Value Chart High')<br>        value_chart_low = pd.Series((ohlc.low - float_axis) / vol_unit, name='Value Chart Low')<br>        value_chart_close = pd.Series((ohlc.close - float_axis) / vol_unit, name='Value Chart Close')<br>        value_chart_open = pd.Series((ohlc.open - float_axis) / vol_unit, name='Value Chart Open')<br>        return pd.concat([value_chart_high, value_chart_low, value_chart_close, value_chart_open], axis=1)</code></pre> |

| <a id="kernel_4ef42a01d8f63c34"></a>kernel_4ef42a01d8f63c34；Python；入口：TA.VBM；归属：FinTA | <pre><code>from __future__ import annotations<br>import numpy as np<br>import pandas as pd<br>from pandas import DataFrame,Series<br>class TA:<br>    @classmethod<br>    def VBM(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, roc_period: int=12, atr_period: int=26, column: str='close') -&gt; Series:<br>        return (ohlc[column] - ohlc[column].shift(roc_period)) / cls.ATR(ohlc, atr_period)<br>    @classmethod<br>    def ATR(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=14) -&gt; Series:<br>        TR = cls.TR(ohlc)<br>        return pd.Series(TR.rolling(center=False, window=period).mean(), name='{0} period ATR'.format(period))<br>    @classmethod<br>    def TR(cls, ohlc: DataFrame) -&gt; Series:<br>        TR1 = pd.Series(ohlc['high'] - ohlc['low']).abs()<br>        TR2 = pd.Series(ohlc['high'] - ohlc['close'].shift()).abs()<br>        TR3 = pd.Series(ohlc['close'].shift() - ohlc['low']).abs()<br>        _TR = pd.concat([TR1, TR2, TR3], axis=1)<br>        _TR['TR'] = _TR.max(axis=1)<br>        return pd.Series(_TR['TR'], name='TR')</code></pre> |

| <a id="kernel_528653a9f4d39b05"></a>kernel_528653a9f4d39b05；Python；入口：TA.MOBO；归属：FinTA | <pre><code>from __future__ import annotations<br>import numpy as np<br>import pandas as pd<br>from pandas import DataFrame,Series<br>class TA:<br>    @classmethod<br>    def MOBO(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=10, std_multiplier: float=0.8, column: str='close') -&gt; DataFrame:<br>        BB = TA.BBANDS(ohlc, period=10, std_multiplier=0.8, column=column)<br>        return BB<br>    @classmethod<br>    def BBANDS(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=20, MA: Series=None, column: str='close', std_multiplier: float=2) -&gt; DataFrame:<br>        std = ohlc[column].rolling(window=period).std()<br>        if not isinstance(MA, pd.core.series.Series):<br>            middle_band = pd.Series(cls.SMA(ohlc, period), name='BB_MIDDLE')<br>        else:<br>            middle_band = pd.Series(MA, name='BB_MIDDLE')<br>        upper_bb = pd.Series(middle_band + std_multiplier * std, name='BB_UPPER')<br>        lower_bb = pd.Series(middle_band - std_multiplier * std, name='BB_LOWER')<br>        return pd.concat([upper_bb, middle_band, lower_bb], axis=1)<br>    @classmethod<br>    def SMA(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=41, column: str='close') -&gt; Series:<br>        return pd.Series(ohlc[column].rolling(window=period).mean(), name='{0} period SMA'.format(period))</code></pre> |

| <a id="kernel_5619d85d352d50fa"></a>kernel_5619d85d352d50fa；Python；入口：TA.CHANDELIER；归属：FinTA | <pre><code>from __future__ import annotations<br>import numpy as np<br>import pandas as pd<br>from pandas import DataFrame,Series<br>class TA:<br>    @classmethod<br>    def CHANDELIER(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, short_period: int=22, long_period: int=22, k: int=3) -&gt; DataFrame:<br>        l = pd.Series(ohlc['high'].rolling(window=long_period).max() - cls.ATR(ohlc, 22) * k, name='Long.')<br>        s = pd.Series(ohlc['low'].rolling(window=short_period).min() + cls.ATR(ohlc, 22) * k, name='Short.')<br>        return pd.concat([s, l], axis=1)<br>    @classmethod<br>    def ATR(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=14) -&gt; Series:<br>        TR = cls.TR(ohlc)<br>        return pd.Series(TR.rolling(center=False, window=period).mean(), name='{0} period ATR'.format(period))<br>    @classmethod<br>    def TR(cls, ohlc: DataFrame) -&gt; Series:<br>        TR1 = pd.Series(ohlc['high'] - ohlc['low']).abs()<br>        TR2 = pd.Series(ohlc['high'] - ohlc['close'].shift()).abs()<br>        TR3 = pd.Series(ohlc['close'].shift() - ohlc['low']).abs()<br>        _TR = pd.concat([TR1, TR2, TR3], axis=1)<br>        _TR['TR'] = _TR.max(axis=1)<br>        return pd.Series(_TR['TR'], name='TR')</code></pre> |

| <a id="kernel_59e7df5977c316da"></a>kernel_59e7df5977c316da；Python；入口：TA.VORTEX；归属：FinTA | <pre><code>from __future__ import annotations<br>import numpy as np<br>import pandas as pd<br>from pandas import DataFrame,Series<br>class TA:<br>    @classmethod<br>    def VORTEX(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=14) -&gt; DataFrame:<br>        VMP = pd.Series((ohlc['high'] - ohlc['low'].shift()).abs())<br>        VMM = pd.Series((ohlc['low'] - ohlc['high'].shift()).abs())<br>        VMPx = VMP.rolling(window=period).sum()<br>        VMMx = VMM.rolling(window=period).sum()<br>        TR = cls.TR(ohlc).rolling(window=period).sum()<br>        VIp = pd.Series(VMPx / TR, name='VIp').interpolate(method='index')<br>        VIm = pd.Series(VMMx / TR, name='VIm').interpolate(method='index')<br>        return pd.concat([VIm, VIp], axis=1)<br>    @classmethod<br>    def TR(cls, ohlc: DataFrame) -&gt; Series:<br>        TR1 = pd.Series(ohlc['high'] - ohlc['low']).abs()<br>        TR2 = pd.Series(ohlc['high'] - ohlc['close'].shift()).abs()<br>        TR3 = pd.Series(ohlc['close'].shift() - ohlc['low']).abs()<br>        _TR = pd.concat([TR1, TR2, TR3], axis=1)<br>        _TR['TR'] = _TR.max(axis=1)<br>        return pd.Series(_TR['TR'], name='TR')</code></pre> |

| <a id="kernel_5ef5d3afc4ae8ab1"></a>kernel_5ef5d3afc4ae8ab1；Python；入口：TA.STOCHRSI；归属：FinTA | <pre><code>from __future__ import annotations<br>import numpy as np<br>import pandas as pd<br>from pandas import DataFrame,Series<br>class TA:<br>    @classmethod<br>    def STOCHRSI(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, rsi_period: int=14, stoch_period: int=14) -&gt; Series:<br>        rsi = cls.RSI(ohlc, rsi_period)<br>        lo = rsi.rolling(stoch_period, min_periods=stoch_period).min()<br>        hi = rsi.rolling(stoch_period, min_periods=stoch_period).max()<br>        return ((rsi - lo) / (hi - lo)).rolling(stoch_period, min_periods=stoch_period).mean()<br>    @classmethod<br>    def RSI(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=14, column: str='close', adjust: bool=True) -&gt; Series:<br>        delta = ohlc[column].diff()<br>        (up, down) = (delta.copy(), delta.copy())<br>        up[up &lt; 0] = 0<br>        down[down &gt; 0] = 0<br>        _gain = up.ewm(alpha=1.0 / period, adjust=adjust).mean()<br>        _loss = down.abs().ewm(alpha=1.0 / period, adjust=adjust).mean()<br>        RS = _gain / _loss<br>        return pd.Series(100 - 100 / (1 + RS), name='{0} period RSI'.format(period))</code></pre> |

| <a id="kernel_668011808ee4bd4b"></a>kernel_668011808ee4bd4b；Python；入口：TA.APZ；归属：FinTA | <pre><code>from __future__ import annotations<br>import numpy as np<br>import pandas as pd<br>from pandas import DataFrame,Series<br>class TA:<br>    @classmethod<br>    def APZ(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=21, dev_factor: int=2, MA: Series=None, adjust: bool=True) -&gt; DataFrame:<br>        if not isinstance(MA, pd.Series):<br>            MA = cls.DEMA(ohlc, period)<br>        price_range = pd.Series((ohlc['high'] - ohlc['low']).ewm(span=period, adjust=adjust).mean())<br>        volatility_value = pd.Series(price_range.ewm(span=period, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='vol_val')<br>        upper_band = pd.Series(volatility_value * dev_factor + MA, name='UPPER')<br>        lower_band = pd.Series(MA - volatility_value * dev_factor, name='LOWER')<br>        return pd.concat([upper_band, lower_band], axis=1)<br>    @classmethod<br>    def DEMA(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=9, column: str='close', adjust: bool=True) -&gt; Series:<br>        DEMA = 2 * cls.EMA(ohlc, period) - cls.EMA(ohlc, period).ewm(span=period, adjust=adjust).mean()<br>        return pd.Series(DEMA, name='{0} period DEMA'.format(period))<br>    @classmethod<br>    def EMA(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=9, column: str='close', adjust: bool=True) -&gt; Series:<br>        return pd.Series(ohlc[column].ewm(span=period, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='{0} period EMA'.format(period))</code></pre> |

| <a id="kernel_88a7fe4bc1b27067"></a>kernel_88a7fe4bc1b27067；Python；入口：TA.EV_MACD；归属：FinTA | <pre><code>from __future__ import annotations<br>import numpy as np<br>import pandas as pd<br>from pandas import DataFrame,Series<br>class TA:<br>    @classmethod<br>    def EV_MACD(cls, ohlcv: DataFrame, period_fast: int=20, period_slow: int=40, signal: int=9, adjust: bool=True) -&gt; DataFrame:<br>        evwma_slow = cls.EVWMA(ohlcv, period_slow)<br>        evwma_fast = cls.EVWMA(ohlcv, period_fast)<br>        MACD = pd.Series(evwma_fast - evwma_slow, name='MACD')<br>        MACD_signal = pd.Series(MACD.ewm(ignore_na=False, span=signal, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='SIGNAL')<br>        return pd.concat([MACD, MACD_signal], axis=1)<br>    @classmethod<br>    def EVWMA(cls, ohlcv: DataFrame, period: int=20) -&gt; Series:<br>        vol_sum = ohlcv['volume'].rolling(window=period).sum()<br>        x = (vol_sum - ohlcv['volume']) / vol_sum<br>        y = ohlcv['volume'] * ohlcv['close'] / vol_sum<br>        evwma = [0]<br>        for (x, y) in zip(x.fillna(0).items(), y.items()):<br>            if x[1] == 0 or y[1] == 0:<br>                evwma.append(0)<br>            else:<br>                evwma.append(evwma[-1] * x[1] + y[1])<br>        return pd.Series(evwma[1:], index=ohlcv.index, name='{0} period EVWMA.'.format(period))</code></pre> |

| <a id="kernel_8f18ed83a001c30c"></a>kernel_8f18ed83a001c30c；Python；入口：TA.KC；归属：FinTA | <pre><code>from __future__ import annotations<br>import numpy as np<br>import pandas as pd<br>from pandas import DataFrame,Series<br>class TA:<br>    @classmethod<br>    def KC(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=20, atr_period: int=10, MA: Series=None, kc_mult: float=2) -&gt; DataFrame:<br>        if not isinstance(MA, pd.core.series.Series):<br>            middle = pd.Series(cls.EMA(ohlc, period), name='KC_MIDDLE')<br>        else:<br>            middle = pd.Series(MA, name='KC_MIDDLE')<br>        up = pd.Series(middle + kc_mult * cls.ATR(ohlc, atr_period), name='KC_UPPER')<br>        down = pd.Series(middle - kc_mult * cls.ATR(ohlc, atr_period), name='KC_LOWER')<br>        return pd.concat([up, down], axis=1)<br>    @classmethod<br>    def EMA(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=9, column: str='close', adjust: bool=True) -&gt; Series:<br>        return pd.Series(ohlc[column].ewm(span=period, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='{0} period EMA'.format(period))<br>    @classmethod<br>    def ATR(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=14) -&gt; Series:<br>        TR = cls.TR(ohlc)<br>        return pd.Series(TR.rolling(center=False, window=period).mean(), name='{0} period ATR'.format(period))<br>    @classmethod<br>    def TR(cls, ohlc: DataFrame) -&gt; Series:<br>        TR1 = pd.Series(ohlc['high'] - ohlc['low']).abs()<br>        TR2 = pd.Series(ohlc['high'] - ohlc['close'].shift()).abs()<br>        TR3 = pd.Series(ohlc['close'].shift() - ohlc['low']).abs()<br>        _TR = pd.concat([TR1, TR2, TR3], axis=1)<br>        _TR['TR'] = _TR.max(axis=1)<br>        return pd.Series(_TR['TR'], name='TR')</code></pre> |

| <a id="kernel_bea8c6cdd75580a8"></a>kernel_bea8c6cdd75580a8；Python；入口：TA.PSAR；归属：FinTA | <pre><code>from __future__ import annotations<br>import numpy as np<br>import pandas as pd<br>from pandas import DataFrame,Series<br>class TA:<br>    @classmethod<br>    def PSAR(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, iaf: int=0.02, maxaf: int=0.2) -&gt; DataFrame:<br>        length = len(ohlc)<br>        (high, low, close) = (ohlc.high, ohlc.low, ohlc.close)<br>        psar = close.copy()<br>        psarbull = [None] * length<br>        psarbear = [None] * length<br>        bull = True<br>        af = iaf<br>        hp = high.iloc[0]<br>        lp = low.iloc[0]<br>        for i in range(2, length):<br>            if bull:<br>                psar[i] = psar[i - 1] + af * (hp - psar[i - 1])<br>            else:<br>                psar[i] = psar[i - 1] + af * (lp - psar[i - 1])<br>            reverse = False<br>            if bull:<br>                if low.iloc[i] &lt; psar[i]:<br>                    bull = False<br>                    reverse = True<br>                    psar[i] = hp<br>                    lp = low.iloc[i]<br>                    af = iaf<br>            elif high.iloc[i] &gt; psar[i]:<br>                bull = True<br>                reverse = True<br>                psar[i] = lp<br>                hp = high.iloc[i]<br>                af = iaf<br>            if not reverse:<br>                if bull:<br>                    if high.iloc[i] &gt; hp:<br>                        hp = high.iloc[i]<br>                        af = min(af + iaf, maxaf)<br>                    if low.iloc[i - 1] &lt; psar[i]:<br>                        psar[i] = low.iloc[i - 1]<br>                    if low.iloc[i - 2] &lt; psar[i]:<br>                        psar[i] = low.iloc[i - 2]<br>                else:<br>                    if low.iloc[i] &lt; lp:<br>                        lp = low.iloc[i]<br>                        af = min(af + iaf, maxaf)<br>                    if high.iloc[i - 1] &gt; psar[i]:<br>                        psar[i] = high.iloc[i - 1]<br>                    if high.iloc[i - 2] &gt; psar[i]:<br>                        psar[i] = high.iloc[i - 2]<br>            if bull:<br>                psarbull[i] = psar[i]<br>            else:<br>                psarbear[i] = psar[i]<br>        return pd.DataFrame({'psar':np.asarray(psar),'psarbull':psarbull,'psarbear':psarbear},index=ohlc.index)</code></pre> |

| <a id="kernel_fac5755e6a2899c0"></a>kernel_fac5755e6a2899c0；Python；入口：TA.TSI；归属：FinTA | <pre><code>from __future__ import annotations<br>import numpy as np<br>import pandas as pd<br>from pandas import DataFrame,Series<br>class TA:<br>    @classmethod<br>    def TSI(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, long: int=25, short: int=13, signal: int=13, column: str='close', adjust: bool=True) -&gt; DataFrame:<br>        momentum = pd.Series(ohlc[column].diff())<br>        _EMA25 = pd.Series(momentum.ewm(span=long, min_periods=long - 1, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='_price change EMA25')<br>        _DEMA13 = pd.Series(_EMA25.ewm(span=short, min_periods=short - 1, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='_price change double smoothed DEMA13')<br>        absmomentum = pd.Series(ohlc[column].diff().abs())<br>        _aEMA25 = pd.Series(absmomentum.ewm(span=long, min_periods=long - 1, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='_abs_price_change EMA25')<br>        _aDEMA13 = pd.Series(_aEMA25.ewm(span=short, min_periods=short - 1, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='_abs_price_change double smoothed DEMA13')<br>        TSI = pd.Series(_DEMA13 / _aDEMA13 * 100, name='TSI')<br>        signal = pd.Series(TSI.ewm(span=signal, min_periods=signal - 1, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='signal')<br>        return pd.concat([TSI, signal], axis=1)</code></pre> |

### 验证范围

| 检查项 | 结果与限制 |
| --- | --- |
| 字段/命名/去向 | 所有保留输入均逐字段核对最新版16表设计；名称字符、周期后缀、现有名称冲突、九类别、原来源ID去向、内部数值核链接均校验。 |
| 数值探测 | 对TA-Lib/Tulip独立C核编译，对FinTA/Pandas TA/PyTI/Stockstats及新增本地技术核独立执行；统一审计731个输出，两组各1000根确定性合成OHLCV，比较17/61/173/347根前缀，明示预热保护后通过。Alpha191另做780×8合成面板前缀探测。不是全量真实行情测试，不承诺发现所有数值边界。 |
| 生产改动边界 | 只更新两份Markdown报告。因子源码、配置、字段文档不改；未声称本报告每个候选都已写入生产框架或完成真实历史PIT验证。 |
